attchmntText: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has provided the audio recording link for the Investors Earning Conference Call held on November 11, 2026. The call discussed financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available at moneyboxxfinance.com/storage/files/investor-meet/1794384974_file.mp3. This information is also posted on the company website at www.moneyboxxfinance.com. The intimation was issued pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. It references a prior intimation dated November 05, 2026. Lalit Sharma, Company Secretary, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "Moneyboxx Finance Q2 FY27: Pre-Provision Opera􀆟ng Profit Up 79% YoY and 4xQoQ; Monthly Disbursements Double to Over ₹50 Crore in October".
voiceSummary: Moneyboxx Finance Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, as approved by its Board of Directors on November 6, 2026. Pre-Provision Operating Profit rose 79% year-on-year to Rs. 9.97 crore. Profit After Tax increased 3.2 times year-on-year to Rs. 0.90 crore. Net interest and fee income grew 28% quarter-on-quarter to Rs. 39.64 crore. Total assets reached Rs. 1,057 crore, classifying the company as a Middle Layer NBFC. Monthly disbursements doubled to over Rs. 50 crore in October 2026. The 90+ PAR ratio improved to 2.56%. The company raised Rs. 110 crore through Non-Convertible Debentures during the quarter.

attchmntText: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Moneyboxx Finance Limited submitted copies of newspaper publications to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The filings relate to the outcome of the Board Meeting. The publications contain un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express in English and Jansatta in Hindi. Both newspapers are dated November 07, 2026. The intimation follows a previous notice dated November 06, 2026. Lalit Sharma, Company Secretary, signed the letter on behalf of the company.
